name: Quantitative Biology PhD
detailsNote: Official annual deadlines; Fall 2027 recruiting faculty confirmed, but deadline year not explicitly attached. Direct-admit and rotation routes coexist; no single admission model assigned.

applicationFee.note: International or domestic foreign-coursework applicants $90; domestic all-US coursework $75. Ask department for waiver code before applying; confirm eligibility. Additional FCSA foreign-transcript review fee $90 is separate.

english.toefl: 4 new / 79 legacy overall; department legacy Speaking23
english.note: Biology additionally lists IELTS Speaking 7 or legacy TOEFL Speaking 23/TSE 45. Admission exemption: qualifying-country schooling or US-accredited degree; other waivers need adviser/dean approval. GTA testing has separate alternatives/exemptions; DET cannot substitute for GTA oral proof.

documents: Foreign transcripts for FCSA review when applicable
requirements.note: Bachelor in biology or 12 advanced biology credits; master-route biology master/30 graduate biology credits. GPA 3 expected. Direct route requires faculty backing; rotation applicants should contact at least 2 potential hosts and identify up to 3 labs. Three rotations, fall only.

funding.note: Five years support via GTA/GRA. Full-time assistantship students receive in-state tuition regardless of residence, with most tuition paid; not a full tuition waiver. No current stipend amount stated.
